title: Production Coordinator, Media Operations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 The Production Coordinator will be an integral member of the Airbnb Scaled Ops Department. This specialized team encompasses a broad spectrum of creative disciplines, including design, photography, and video, dedicated to maintaining and promoting the visual identity of the brand.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 You will help elevate the overall quality of Airbnb Homes, Experiences & Services through high quality photo merchandising, and forge meaningful connections between Airbnb's brand and its rapidly expanding community.
 The role demands a candidate who is adept at guiding projects to completion efficiently and effectively. The ideal applicant will be self-driven, capable of motivating others, and excel in delivering creative solutions despite changing constraints. A collaborative attitude, empathy, and a resolute focus are essential qualities, to ensure clear and effective communication across all levels of production and with stakeholders.
 A Typical Day:
 Deliver assignment feedback to photographers based on editor’s notes
 Track the delivery of appearance releases and ensure they are in the proper folders
 Recruit photographers in high priority markets where we are unable to meet photoshoot demand
 Negotiate additional travel compensation with photographers in order to encourage them to accept assignments outside of their market coverage.
 Carefully review host feedback received via email and the NPS form, and ensure action is being taken on every assignment.
 Identify themes in both photographer and host feedback to go back into our training and prep materials.

title: Staff Product Manager, Agent Studio
description:
At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

The Mission

Your product mission is to make Algolia the builder-first platform for agentic applications. Agent Studio empowers developers and business users to compose retrieval, memory, workflows, tools, and evaluation in one place - then ship those workflows to production with confidence. You will equip customers with the ability to go from prototype to production quickly, reliably, and with governance built in.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Product Manager at Algolia, you will shape the vision and execution of Agent Studio, the front door to Algolia’s Agentic Platform. This role is critical in defining how Algolia becomes the default environment for building, evaluating, and scaling agent workflows. You will collaborate across engineering, design, product marketing, and GTM to deliver impactful results, multiply the impact of other PMs, and contribute directly to the company’s long-term success.

What you'll be doing:

  • Drive product discovery to define the who, why, and what of Agent Studio.
  • Formulate, align, and communicate the strategy, vision, and roadmap for Agent Studio across the organization.
